scope: TTL 60s fixed; actual HTTP/owned MySQL and Redis; cache read OFF/ON (both retain DB revision writes).
worktree: Uncommitted implementation and test files; source hashes identify measured sources.

measurement.conditions: 200 scheduled reads/50ms; four readers; one writer at +25ms, then 500ms or 100ms; 10 warmups; OFF retains revision writes; two counterbalanced rounds; no TTL sweep

phases.correctness: all HTTP/SQL succeeded; full DTO allowed-state match; exact revision delta and DB likes; post-measurement sentinel changes the initial DTO and fresh HTTP equals independent expectation and DB
